messages:
maria: heads up — i flipped the experimental 'breakglass-routing' flag in staging to validate sdk fallback behavior. seeing quota attribution drop on the console and some 502s in go-sdk integration tests. should i revert?

dan: which sdk versions are hitting staging? any stack traces or short logs?

maria: go@v0.8.1 and ts@1.4.0. minimal log: 
```
rpc: route-negotiation failed: missing header x-rd-route-v2
http: 502 upstream_disconnect
```

ashok: looks like header negotiation. the new header is x-rd-route-v2; older clients still emit x-rd-route. runtime accepts both but the telemetry pipeline (console mapping) only looks for v2. that would explain the attribution dip.

kia: ah — so traffic still routed correctly but the console isn't recognizing the older header as a route hint? can we patch the mapping quickly?

maria: correct — routing falls back to the default pool but quota counts go to the fallback bucket because console can't join the older header. turning the flag off immediately drops 502s and the numbers return.

dan: is the gateway strict about header names? we could add a shim to canonicalize headers server-side while we finish client updates.

ashok: gateway shim makes sense and is low-risk — accept x-rd-route as x-rd-route-v2 for the rollout window. i'll take it. also suggest adding a telemetry event from the sdk when fallback used, e.g. "route.header.fallback": true. that helps dashboards.

maria: plan suggestion: 1) gateway shim -> accept both headers (ashok) 2) console telemetry mapping -> union keys for the rollout (kia) 3) ship small sdk hotfix to ts/go to emit v2 (but include old header for 2 weeks) 4) add metric route.header.fallback from client libs to ease monitoring

dan: can we run a 1% prod canary after the shim + console change? also add alert on quota deviation and 5xx rate.

maria: yes to canary. i've created a quick branch in the ts sdk to emit both headers: 
```
// ts client
if (featureFlags.breakglassRouting) {
  headers['x-rd-route-v2'] = routeHint;
  headers['x-rd-route'] = routeHint; // shim compat
}
```

kia: i'll open the console PR to treat both headers as route_id and add a transient dashboard tile called "route-header-mismatch" that shows older vs v2 counts.

ashok: gateway shim PR incoming. i'll also add a tiny telemetry tag we can surface: route.header.source=[sdk,v1]. increment when fallback path used.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: gateway/shim-accept-old-header -> staging (sha: a1b2c3), ETA ~3m

sdk-bot: ts-sdk branch pushed (feature/breakglass-compat), tests all green in CI except one flaky integ that is unrelated.

dan: once shim is in staging + console mapping preview ready, let's flip the flag to 5% in staging and watch for 502s + quota convergence. if stable, 1% prod canary next.

maria: sounds good. holding on the sdk release until console PR merged and canary green. thanks all :pray: 

kia: FYI i added a note on the console PR to keep mapping tolerant for 14 days then require v2.

ashok: same — i'll add a 2-week TTL to the gateway shim with explicit log message when shim is used. helps cleanup later.

maria: perfect. i'll follow up with a postmortem-style thread if any surprises during canary.

dan: great coordination.

maria: reverting the flag now in staging while we land the shim so prod traffic unaffected. will re-enable for 5% after green.
